name: DDRNet23-Slim (street scenes)
description: Labels every pixel of a street photo with one of the 19 Cityscapes classes: road, sidewalk, building, vegetation, terrain, sky, cars, people and more. Small and fast: it runs on a CPU with onnxruntime, about a fifth of a second per image, and needs no download.
publisher: DDRNet authors; ONNX export by Qualcomm AI Hub Models (v0.63.0, w8a8)
